# lockdocs

> Exact-version library docs from your lockfile — local, offline, no rate limits.

lockdocs is a Rust command-line tool and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Sylphx (`https://sylphx.com`). It reads your project's lockfile (`Cargo.lock`, `bun.lock`, `package-lock.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `yarn.lock`, `uv.lock`, `poetry.lock`, `go.sum`) and serves the documentation and API symbols for the exact versions your project installed — locally and offline, with no API key and no rate limits.

## Install and Setup

- npm: `npx -y @sylphx/lockdocs setup --client cursor,claude,codex`
- Cargo: `cargo install lockdocs`
- Homebrew: `brew install sylphxai/tap/lockdocs`
